title: Binary and Application Name: zapi-cli → zapi
description: Rename the published binary from 'zapi-cli' to 'zapi' by updating the AssemblyName in ZapiCli.csproj, changing SetApplicationName in Program.cs, and updating all references in publish-all.sh, README.md, and docs/HELP.md. This is the foundation rename — all downstream stories depend on the binary name being 'zapi'.
prerequisiteState: Stories 1–25 complete. The CLI binary is currently published as 'zapi-cli'. All doc references and the publish script use 'zapi-cli'. Spectre.Console has ApplicationName set to 'zapi-cli'.
goal: After this story: dotnet publish produces a binary named 'zapi'. Running './zapi --help' works. HELP.md and README.md installation instructions reference 'zapi', not 'zapi-cli'. The publish script produces 'zapi' outputs under each build/*/platform/ folder.
scope: In src/ZapiCli/ZapiCli.csproj: change <AssemblyName>zapi-cli</AssemblyName> to <AssemblyName>zapi</AssemblyName>. If <AssemblyName> is not explicitly set, add it. Also change <RootNamespace> only if it matches 'zapi-cli' (it likely does not — keep 'ZapiCli' as the namespace).
In src/ZapiCli/Program.cs: change config.SetApplicationName("zapi-cli") to config.SetApplicationName("zapi").

In publish-all.sh: update all output binary reference strings from 'zapi-cli' to 'zapi' — specifically every platform output path like 'build/osx-arm64/zapi-cli' should become 'build/osx-arm64/zapi'. Review the full script to catch chmod, cp, or rename operations that reference the old name.

In docs/HELP.md: find-and-replace all occurrences of 'zapi-cli' with 'zapi' in command-line examples, usage blocks, and installation instructions. Do NOT replace prose text that says 'the CLI' or 'Zapi CLI' — only replace the literal command name in code spans and usage blocks.

In README.md: same find-and-replace as HELP.md — update all command examples and installation instructions. Keep any prose references to 'zapi-cli' as the *project name* if they distinguish the project from the binary, but change all runnable command examples to 'zapi'.
Do NOT rename the .csproj file itself (keep ZapiCli.csproj), the solution file, or the namespace. Do NOT change the assembly's NuGet package ID if one exists — this is not a library.
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet publish -r osx-arm64 /p:PublishSingleFile=true --self-contained true produces a binary named 'zapi' (not 'zapi-cli')
'./zapi --help' output shows 'zapi' in the usage line, not 'zapi-cli'
publish-all.sh contains no remaining 'zapi-cli' binary references
docs/HELP.md command examples all use 'zapi' not 'zapi-cli'
All existing unit tests still pass (no functional change)
contextForAgent: Read the full publish-all.sh before making changes — it may contain build/ folder paths, chmod commands, or packaging steps that reference the binary name in multiple forms. Read Program.cs around the SetApplicationName call (it's in the config lambda, approximately line 100-120). The csproj AssemblyName element may not be explicitly present — in that case add it. The namespace (ZapiCli) and project name (ZapiCli.csproj) should NOT change. Only the output binary name changes.
